text:
Kathy takes the Miami condominium by survivorship. Bill signed and delivered the deed while they were married, so it created a valid tenancy by the entirety, and the prenup waived only rights arising from the marriage, not rights Bill gave her by deed. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture, the remaining assets pass equally to Tommy and Julie, and Julie's specific devise of the condo fails. The team note doesn't hold in Florida, because §732.702 lets a valid written prenuptial waiver bar the elective share and the pretermitted-spouse share, so Kathy gets nothing further from the estate.

CONFIDENCE: 82
